name: SBOM Author
definition: The name of the entity that creates the SBOM data for the target component.
description: The SBOM Author element contains a string that identifies the entity that generated the SBOM for the target component. This element captures the entity operating the tool to generate the SBOM, not the tool itself. Inputs for this field should use full names and should not use acronyms (unless the official name of the entity that generated the SBOM includes an acronym). The SBOM Author element is distinct from the Component Producer element, which identifies the entity that created the target component. The SBOM Author and the Component Producer field contents may be identical if the same entity created the target component and generated the SBOM. In cases where an entity that did not create the target component generates the SBOM for the target component, the field contents will be different.
definition_ko: 대상 컴포넌트의 SBOM 데이터를 생성하는 주체의 이름.
description_ko: SBOM을 생성한 주체를 식별하는 문자열을 담는다. 도구가 아니라 그 도구를 운용한 주체를 적으며, 약어가 공식 명칭의 일부가 아닌 한 전체 이름을 쓴다. 대상 컴포넌트를 만든 주체를 가리키는 Component Producer와는 구별되며, 같은 주체가 컴포넌트를 만들고 SBOM도 생성했다면 두 값이 같을 수 있다.

name: SBOM Author Signature
definition: A digital signature attributable to the SBOM author.
description: The SBOM Author Signature element provides assurance that the claimed signatory signed the information and that the information was not modified after signature generation.  Digital signatures should use a signature algorithm approved for secure use, according to regulations or recommendations from relevant authorities, such as the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Digital Signature Standard (DSS), the International Organization for Standardization (ISO)/International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 14888-4:2024, or the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms.
description_ko: 서명자가 그 정보에 서명했고 서명 이후 정보가 변경되지 않았음을 보장한다. 서명 알고리즘은 NIST DSS, ISO/IEC 14888-4:2024, ENISA 권고 암호 메커니즘처럼 관련 당국이 안전하다고 승인한 것을 써야 한다.

name: SBOM Data Format Name
definition: The name of the data format used to represent the SBOM data.
description: The SBOM Data Format Name element identifies the data format used to generate and consume the SBOM. See Machine-Processable Data for information on SBOM data formats.
definition_ko: SBOM 데이터를 표현하는 데 사용된 데이터 형식의 이름.
description_ko: SBOM을 생성하고 소비하는 데 쓰인 데이터 형식을 식별한다.

name: SBOM Data Format Version
definition: Identifier designated by the SBOM data format to specify the version of the data format.
description: The SBOM Data Format Version element identifies the version of the data format indicated in the SBOM Data Format Name element. Versions declared to be deprecated by the organizations maintaining the data format should not be used.
definition_ko: 데이터 형식의 버전을 지정하기 위해 그 데이터 형식이 정한 식별자.
description_ko: SBOM 데이터 형식 이름에서 가리킨 형식의 버전을 식별한다. 형식을 유지하는 조직이 폐기(deprecated)로 선언한 버전은 쓰지 않아야 한다.

name: SBOM Generation Context
definition: The relative software lifecycle phase and data available at the time the SBOM author generated the SBOM.
description: The SBOM Generation Context element conveys information about the component data documented in the SBOM. Component data may differ based on the phase of the software lifecycle during which the SBOM was generated. General software lifecycle references such as “before build,” “build,” and “after build,” as well as more specific identifiers, can satisfy this element.  For example, an SBOM generated from source code could be identified as “before build,” and binary analysis tools can generate an SBOM “after build.”
definition_ko: SBOM 작성자가 SBOM을 생성한 시점의 상대적 소프트웨어 수명주기 단계와 그때 이용 가능했던 데이터.
description_ko: SBOM에 기록된 컴포넌트 데이터에 관한 정황을 전한다. 컴포넌트 데이터는 SBOM이 생성된 수명주기 단계에 따라 달라질 수 있다. "빌드 전"·"빌드"·"빌드 후" 같은 일반적 표현이나 더 구체적인 식별자로 이 요소를 충족할 수 있다.

name: SBOM Timestamp
definition: Record of the date and time of the most recent update to the SBOM data.
description: The SBOM Timestamp element identifies when the SBOM author last changed the SBOM data, either manually or using a software tool. Each version of an SBOM will have a new timestamp. The content of this field should adhere to RFC 9557.
definition_ko: SBOM 데이터가 가장 최근에 갱신된 날짜와 시각의 기록.
description_ko: SBOM 작성자가 수동으로든 도구로든 SBOM 데이터를 마지막으로 변경한 시점을 식별한다. SBOM의 각 버전은 새 타임스탬프를 갖는다. 이 필드의 내용은 RFC 9557을 따라야 한다.

name: SBOM Tool Name
definition: The name of the tool used by the SBOM author to generate or amend the SBOM.
description: The SBOM Tool Name element contains a string that identifies the software tool that the SBOM author used to generate the SBOM. Inputs for this field should use full names and should not use acronyms (unless the tool’s official name includes an acronym).
definition_ko: SBOM 작성자가 SBOM을 생성하거나 수정하는 데 사용한 도구의 이름.
description_ko: SBOM 작성자가 SBOM 생성에 사용한 소프트웨어 도구를 식별하는 문자열을 담는다. 약어가 도구의 공식 명칭의 일부가 아닌 한 전체 이름을 쓴다.

name: SBOM Tool Version
definition: Identifier for the version of the tool identified in the SBOM Tool Name element.
description: The SBOM Tool Version element captures the tool version and allows an organization to identify a specific code delivery. If no version identifier is available, the SBOM author should indicate that the information is unknown.
definition_ko: SBOM 도구 이름에서 식별한 도구의 버전 식별자.
description_ko: 도구의 버전을 담아 특정 코드 배포본을 식별할 수 있게 한다. 버전 식별자가 없으면 작성자는 정보가 알려지지 않았음을 표시해야 한다.

name: SBOM Version
definition: Identifier designated by the SBOM author to specify a change in the SBOM document from a previously identified version or to indicate that it is the first version.
description: The SBOM Version element indicates a relationship with earlier iterations of an SBOM and signals that the SBOM author made changes to the previous iteration. The SBOM version is the version of an SBOM for each component-name/component-version pair. The SBOM Version element may use Semantic Versioning;  if the SBOM author uses Semantic Versioning, the major version of a published SBOM following these minimum elements should be “1.”  SBOM authors should use minor version and patch version to indicate changes to the content of the SBOM elements as appropriate. If using an identifier such as a serial number to differentiate between versions of an SBOM, use of the identifier should conform to relevant standards (for example, RFC 9562 for unique identifiers). SBOM authors should update the version for an SBOM for a given component-name/component-version pair when editing data about the target component. Component Data elements capture information about the target component (the component for which the SBOM is generated) and all enumerated subcomponents. Analysis of this data provides information about the components and their relationships and enables better informed risk management decisions regarding the target component.
definition_ko: 이전에 식별된 버전으로부터의 변경을 지정하거나 첫 버전임을 나타내기 위해 SBOM 작성자가 정한 식별자.
description_ko: 이전 SBOM과의 관계를 나타내고 작성자가 그 이전 판을 변경했음을 알린다. SBOM 버전은 컴포넌트 이름·버전 쌍마다의 SBOM 버전이다. 시맨틱 버저닝을 쓸 수 있으며, 그 경우 이 최소요소를 따르는 공표 SBOM의 주(major) 버전은 "1"이어야 한다.

name: Component Producer
definition: The name of an entity that creates, defines, and identifies components.
description: The Component Producer element contains a human-readable string that identifies the entity that created or developed the target component.  The Component Producer element can enable the identification of a point of contact for software security concerns. Only one organization should be identified as the component producer for a given component. This practice will help distinguish between components of the “manufacturer.” While all manufactures are producers, not all producers are manufacturers. For more information, see: EU, “Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Article same name produced by different component producers. Inputs for this field should use full names and should not use acronyms (unless the component producer’s official name includes an acronym). For open source software projects, the Component Producer field remains important. Naming practices may vary depending on how the project develops, distributes, and maintains packages and files. Certain ecosystems provide conventions for naming component producers through package managers. Otherwise, the SBOM author should use the original project or maintaining organization, when available. If there is no clear indication of component producer, the SBOM author should explicitly indicate that the component is of unknown provenance to acknowledge the lack of traceability. The Component Producer element replaces the Supplier Name element from the 2021 SBOM Minimum Elements. Supplier Name has proven ambiguous in practice, particularly around distributors of software. Although reduced by the change to “Component Producer,” some ambiguity will remain until there is a consensus methodology for identifying entities that create software.
definition_ko: 컴포넌트를 만들고 정의하고 식별하는 주체의 이름.
description_ko: 대상 컴포넌트를 만들거나 개발한 주체를 식별하는 사람이 읽을 수 있는 문자열을 담는다. 소프트웨어 보안 문제의 연락 지점을 파악하게 해준다. 한 컴포넌트에 대해서는 하나의 조직만 생산자로 식별해야 한다.

name: Component Dependency Relationship
definition: The relationship between two components, where one component is necessary for the operation of the other.
description: The Component Dependency Relationship element reflects that a component includes another component. This information specifies the relationship between the target component and one of its subcomponents and supports the capability to build a dependency graph.  SBOM data formats may structure information about these subcomponents as SBOM elements embedded in the SBOM. Alternatively, an SBOM document can link to separate SBOM documents for each of the target component’s dependencies.
definition_ko: 한 컴포넌트가 다른 컴포넌트의 작동에 필요한, 두 컴포넌트 사이의 관계.
description_ko: 어떤 컴포넌트가 다른 컴포넌트를 포함한다는 사실을 나타낸다. 대상 컴포넌트와 그 하위 컴포넌트의 관계를 지정해 의존 그래프를 만들 수 있게 한다. 하위 컴포넌트를 SBOM 안에 포함해 표현할 수도 있고, 각 의존 대상의 별도 SBOM 문서로 링크할 수도 있다.

name: Component Hash Value
definition: The output generated from applying a cryptographic hash algorithm to an executable component artifact.
description: The Component Hash Value element contains an American Standard Code for Information Interchange (ASCII), hexadecimal encoded value that is the result of providing the executable component artifact as input to a cryptographic hash algorithm.  If the SBOM author does not have access to the executable component artifact, then the SBOM author should indicate the value is unknown.
definition_ko: 실행 가능한 컴포넌트 아티팩트에 암호학적 해시 알고리즘을 적용해 얻은 출력값.
description_ko: 실행 아티팩트를 암호학적 해시 알고리즘에 입력해 얻은 ASCII 16진 인코딩 값을 담는다. 작성자가 실행 아티팩트에 접근할 수 없으면 값이 알려지지 않았음을 표시해야 한다.

name: Component Hash Algorithm
definition: The cryptographic algorithm used to compute the Component Hash Value of the software component.
description: The Component Hash Algorithm element documents the algorithm that produced the Component Hash Value to allow validation of the integrity of the target component. The SBOM author should identify the algorithm using Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) Hash Function Textual Names. The algorithm should be approved by a relevant authority, such as NIST.
definition_ko: 소프트웨어 컴포넌트의 해시 값을 계산하는 데 사용된 암호학적 알고리즘.
description_ko: 해시 값을 만들어낸 알고리즘을 기록해 대상 컴포넌트의 무결성을 검증할 수 있게 한다. 알고리즘은 IANA Hash Function Textual Names로 식별하고, NIST 같은 관련 당국이 승인한 것이어야 한다.

name: Component Identifiers
definition: Identifiers used to identify a component or serve as a look-up key for relevant databases.
description: The Component Identifiers element contains at least one software identifier associated with the target component.  Machine-processable, unique software identifiers support automated analysis. This field should use common software identifiers, such as Common Platform Enumeration (CPE)  and Package-URL (PURL).  This field may also include universally unique identifiers (UUID), organization-specific identifiers, commit hashes, and intrinsic identifiers such as OmniBOR  and Software Hash Identifier (SWHID).  If there are multiple software identifiers, the SBOM author should include all of them.
definition_ko: 컴포넌트를 식별하거나 관련 데이터베이스의 조회 키로 쓰이는 식별자.
description_ko: 대상 컴포넌트와 결부된 소프트웨어 식별자를 최소 하나 담는다. 기계 판독 가능한 고유 식별자는 자동 분석을 뒷받침한다. CPE·PURL 같은 공통 식별자를 쓰고, UUID·조직 고유 식별자·커밋 해시·OmniBOR·SWHID 같은 내재적 식별자도 포함할 수 있다. 식별자가 여럿이면 전부 포함해야 한다.

name: Component License
definition: The identifier(s) for the license(s) under which the software component is available.
description: The Component License element captures the identifiers for the licenses under which the software component is available. The license identifiers should allow an organization receiving the SBOM data to find the full details of the licenses. When possible, the SBOM author should convey this information in a machine-processable fashion, such as by using System Package Data eXchange (SPDX) license identifiers.  If no identifier is available, the contents should indicate through other means where the full license details are available, such as via a URL. This field should also include information about the existence of proprietary license conditions. If the SBOM author is not aware of the license information, then the SBOM author should indicate that license information is unknown.
description_ko: 그 컴포넌트가 어떤 라이선스로 제공되는지의 식별자를 담는다. 식별자는 받는 조직이 라이선스 전문을 찾을 수 있게 해야 한다. 가능하면 SPDX 라이선스 식별자처럼 기계 판독 가능한 방식으로 전달하고, 식별자가 없으면 URL 등으로 전문의 위치를 알린다. 독점 라이선스 조건의 존재 여부도 포함해야 한다.

name: Component Name
definition: The name assigned by the component producer to a software component.
description: The Component Name element identifies the software component in a human-readable way. The component producer determines the component name. This field is distinct from the Component Identifiers field. Data formats implementing the Component Name element should allow for multiple entries to capture alternate names. Inputs for this field should use full names and should not use acronyms (unless the component’s official name includes an acronym).
definition_ko: 컴포넌트 생산자가 소프트웨어 컴포넌트에 부여한 이름.
description_ko: 사람이 읽을 수 있는 방식으로 컴포넌트를 식별한다. 이름은 컴포넌트 생산자가 정한다. 컴포넌트 식별자 필드와는 구별되며, 대체 이름을 담을 수 있도록 여러 항목을 허용해야 한다.

name: Component Version
definition: Identifier used by the component producer to specify a change in a software component from a previously identified version or to indicate that it is the first version.
description: The Component Version element captures the target component’s version and allows an organization to identify a specific code delivery. If the component producer does not provide a version, then the SBOM author should indicate that the information is unknown.
definition_ko: 이전에 식별된 버전으로부터의 변경을 지정하거나 첫 버전임을 나타내기 위해 컴포넌트 생산자가 사용하는 식별자.
description_ko: 대상 컴포넌트의 버전을 담아 특정 코드 배포본을 식별할 수 있게 한다. 생산자가 버전을 제공하지 않으면 작성자는 정보가 알려지지 않았음을 표시해야 한다.
